selection_policy: Filter plain numeric vMAJOR.MINOR[.PATCH] tags; use versions10.0+ to avoid legacy rNN Maven numbering; omit ambiguous v13.0/v13.0-final and maintenance releases23.6.1/24.1.1 published after newer mainline25.0. Sort70 eligible mainline release points by release date and choose round(i*(70-1)/(30-1)) for i=0..29. All30 observations increase chronologically, skip>=1numericstable release between each adjacent pair, and cover26major/minor families. JRE variants only where variants exist; pre23.1 use plain artifacts. No clustering outcome influences selection.
artifact_source: Maven Central released Guava artifacts. Published SHA1 sidecars checked and immutable SHA256 pins recorded.
external_exclusions: Only source-owned com.google.common production classes form the analysis universe
com.google.thirdparty.publicsuffix excluded as bundled third-party code despite residing in the Guava JAR
failureaccess, listenablefuture compatibility artifact, annotation libraries, JDK, all other external classes excluded
Android variant artifacts are not alternate releases and are not analyzed
Beta API annotations in stable Guava releases are retained; prerelease versions are excluded
